ruleDefinitions.name: Discovery of a System Time
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies use of various commands to query a systems time. This technique may be used before executing a scheduled task or to discover the time zone of a target system.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*time.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\w32tm\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*tz.*")))
